strips.title: Setting up a new TV — in real life

panels.head: Unbox
panels.text: New TV, new remote, and a setup screen with a long privacy agreement.

panels.head: Read the agreement
panels.text: Decline viewing data and ad personalization before the first channel.

panels.head: Still ads
panels.text: Some tiles stay, whatever you switch off. Know which ones before you buy.

panels.head: Offline box
panels.text: For zero doubt, keep the TV off Wi-Fi and run a streaming box.
